    ('blend-during-transition', 'transition-blend-limit', 'canvas/blend-modes names blend during a transition'),
    ('consolidate-cursor-files', 'rec-cursor-consolidate', 'projects/consolidate-media lists the files it copies'),
    ('color-filters-around-grade', 'filters-around-the-grade', 'color/color-tab names the fixed grade order'),
    ('color-scopes-follow-preview', 'hdr-scopes-follow-the-frame', 'color/scopes names scopes following the preview'),
    ('fit-new-clips-to-canvas', 'editing-new-clips-fit-the-canvas', 'the setting lives on projects/background-and-timecode'),
    ('gs-mixed-values', 'color-mixed-badge', 'getting-started/inspector-fields names the mixed-value badge for every tab'),
    ('action-band-by-track-height', 'timeline-bands-by-height', 'motion/action-lane names bands by track height'),
    ('export-save-frame-deep', 'deep-frames', 'export/save-frame names deep and HDR frames'),
    ('gs-clip-tab-pinned-block', 'clip-tab-pinned-block', 'getting-started/inspector names the pinned block'),
    ('graphics-copy-a-clip', 'editing-paste-a-graphic-clip', 'what a graphic clip carries is the graphics section\'s to say'),
]

# A short restatement that a page's scope requires it to keep, deferring to the
# entry that owns the feature: (restatement, owner, page class).
MIRRORS = [
    ('timeline-clip-transition-zone', 'transition-zone', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-volume-line', 'audio-volume-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-rate-line', 'speed-rate-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-motion-marks', 'motion-timeline-marks', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-link-marks', 'audio-linked-marks', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-label-dot', 'timeline-clip-labels', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-gate-line', 'hide-while-silent-timeline-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-duck-line', 'audio-duck-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-cached-drawings', 'background-media-caches', 'legend'),
    ('audio-clip-waveforms', 'timeline-clip-waveform', 'overview'),
    ('gs-concept-actions', 'action-overview', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-concept-frame-grid', 'editing-times-land-on-frames', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-concept-clips-never-push', 'editing-clips-never-push', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-refused-drop', 'editing-refused-drop', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-autosave-keeps-your-work', 'autosave-in-place', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-preview-pane', 'timeline-preview-pane', 'getting started'),
    ('framing-analysis-on-demand', 'analysis-on-demand', 'concept'),
    ('framing-analysis-background', 'analysis-in-the-background', 'concept'),
    ('framing-found-faces', 'face-analysis', 'concept'),
    ('framing-found-salient', 'subject-analysis', 'concept'),
    ('assistant-can-graphics', 'graphics-assistant', 'assistant list'),
    ('assistant-cut-false-starts', 'cleanup-false-starts', 'assistant list'),
    ('assistant-cut-filler-words', 'cleanup-assistant-fillers-silences', 'assistant list'),
    ('animate-graphic-properties', 'graphics-animate-with-an-action', 'reference'),
    ('audio-trim-sound-alone', 'editing-sound-clip-alone', 'how-to'),
    ('hdr-frames', 'export-save-frame-deep', 'scope names it'),
    ('image-clip-starting-size', 'fit-new-clips-to-canvas', 'scope names it'),
    ('line-arrowheads-howto', 'shape-arrowheads', 'how-to'),
    ('speed-remove-action', 'remove-action', 'how-to'),
]

# Related entries, each a real entry of its own: a general rule and its case,
# or a sheet and the tool argument behind it. Linked, not merged.
LINKS = [
    ('timeline-preview-tags', 'color-selection-tag'),
    ('timeline-preview-tags', 'color-ungraded-tag'),
    ('timeline-preview-tags', 'sdr-version-tag'),
    ('edit-nest-actions', 'editing-what-a-nest-keeps'),
    ('speed-retime-actions', 'edit-speed-actions'),
    ('export-waits', 'speed-export-waits-for-audio'),
    ('edit-freeze-actions', 'speed-freeze-look'),
    ('editing-what-counts-as-a-hard-cut', 'shot-analysis'),
    ('action-row-menu', 'gs-row-context-menu'),
    ('audio-section-reset', 'gs-section-reset'),
    ('color-copy-qualifier', 'editing-paste-attributes-adjustment-clips'),
    ('reframe-follow-speaker', 'vertical-follow-speaker'),
    ('color-scope-caption', 'hdr-scopes-captions'),
    ('framing-backgrounds-track', 'vertical-blurred-copy'),
    ('reframe-backdrop', 'vertical-blurred-copy'),
    ('reframe-follow-cursor', 'vertical-screen-recordings'),
    ('action-subtab-count', 'graphics-action-badge'),
    ('edit-paste-attributes-actions', 'editing-what-paste-attributes-leaves-alone'),
    ('editing-what-paste-attributes-leaves-alone', 'graphics-paste-attributes-difference'),
    ('action-refused-message', 'gs-refusal-strip'),
    ('audio-sound-not-animated', 'never-animated'),
    ('cleanup-filler-no-key', 'gs-greyed-keyed-commands'),
    ('assistant-your-own-key', 'gs-your-own-keys'),
    ('graphics-animation-range-checks', 'graphics-animated-start-values'),
]

# Tool catalogue rows: which entry a row defers to where the scorer's first
# choice is wrong. None means the tool has no UI (or no single one).
TOOL_OWNER = {
    'cancel_export': 'mcp-export-cancel',
    'export': 'mcp-export-start',
    'export_status': 'mcp-export-status',
    'get_project': 'mcp-get-project',
    'render_frame': 'mcp-render-frame',
    'record_screen': 'mcp-record-screen',
    'get_timeline_transcript': None,
    'get_transcript': None,
    'set_track': None,
    'graphic_reference': 'graphics-agent-reference',
    'set_speed': 'speed-sheet',
    'set_clip': 'timeline-rename-clip',
    'set_media_color': 'camera-log-agents',
    'relink_media': 'relink-one-file',
    'switch_angle': 'switch-angle',
    'switch_by_speaker': 'switch-by-speaker',
    'make_vertical_version': 'make-vertical-version',
    'insert_graphic': 'graphics-insert',
}
# The deep reference pages link out to where a person does the same thing.
DEEP_LINKS = [
    ('mcp-export-start', 'export-sheet'),
    ('mcp-record-screen', 'rec-record-into'),
    ('mcp-render-frame', 'export-save-frame-deep'),
    ('mcp-open-nest', 'editing-open-nest'),
]

# Taxonomy scope corrections, each checked against the code.
TAXONOMY_FIXES = [
    ('editing/add-clips',
     'Dragging a media row to a track, the canvas or past the stack;',
     'Dragging a media row to a track or the canvas;',
     'a media row dropped past the lanes is refused (MediaRowView.swift performDragOperation returns false with no lane under the pointer); only a clip already on the timeline makes a track that way'),
    ('projects/consolidate-media',
     'the Consolidate… button and sheet, free-space check, name and duplicate handling',
     'the Consolidate… button and sheet, name and duplicate handling',
     'Consolidate has no free-space check; the only one is the WebM/MKV rewrap\'s (ContainerRewrap.swift)'),
    ('captions/generate-captions',
     'the sample preview, progress, Stop, the run report',
     'the sample preview, progress, Cancel, the run report',
     'the sheet\'s button is labelled Cancel (sheetCancelButton)'),
]

# Author notes aimed at the taxonomy or the record, turned into the fact.
DETAIL_FIXES = {
    'editing-drops-that-spring-back': [(r'^Code check: a media row dropped above or below the lanes is refused\..*$',
                                        'A media row dropped above or below the lanes is refused. Only a clip already on the timeline makes a new track that way.')],
    'consolidate-media': [(r'^Taxonomy check: the page scope names a free-space check, but MediaConsolidator\.swift has none; ',
                           'There is no free-space check beforehand: ')],
    'generate-cancel': [(r'^Code over a lens: .*$', 'The button is labelled Cancel.')],
    'assistant-missing-helper': [(r'^Code note: no raw record covers this.*$', None)],
    'rec-cursor-file': [(r' \(the guide\'s and the road map\'s "images" are not what the code writes\)', '')],
}

# Pairs the duplicate detector flags that were read and are different things.
# One reason per class; a pair matches by its two ids.
DISTINCT = {
    'different key or service': [('assemblyai-key-environment', 'assistant-env-key'), ('assemblyai-key-storage', 'assistant-key-file'), ('assemblyai-key-remove', 'assistant-remove-key'), ('assemblyai-key-field', 'assistant-save-key')],
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

STOP = set('the a an of to and or in on at is it its for with as by that this be are from your you can when not no one each so if which into than then only'.split())
DEV_NAMES = 'snapshot_ui perform_menu_item cancel_sheet select_inspector_tab play_preview graphic_memory loudness_meter land_recording analysis_job transcript_view playback_rebuilds assistant_send assistant_answer'.split()
DEV = re.compile(r'RCDev|\bdev[- ]tools?\b|dev-only|DEV_TOOLS|' + '|'.join(DEV_NAMES), re.I)
SPEC = re.compile(r'\s*\((?:road map[^)]*|spec §[^)]*)\)|\bspec §\s*[\d.]+[a-z]*(?: [A-Z]+-\d+)?', re.I)
GENERIC_UI = {'timeline', 'automatic', 'preview', 'preview canvas', 'edit undo', 'edit redo'}


def norm(s):
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s.lower()).strip()
    return re.sub(r'^(the|a|an) ', '', s)


def toks(s):
    return {w for w in re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_]+', s.lower()) if w not in STOP}


def sim(a, b):
    return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio()


def jac(a, b):
    return len(a & b) / max(1, len(a | b))


def add_unique(dst, src):
    for x in src:
        if x not in dst:
            dst.append(x)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load

taxonomy = json.load(open(f'{B}/taxonomy.json'))
sections = taxonomy['sections']
pages = {}
page_rank = {}
for s in sorted(sections, key=lambda s: s['order']):
    for p in sorted(s['pages'], key=lambda p: p['order']):
        pages[p['slug']] = (s, p)
        page_rank[p['slug']] = len(page_rank)

raw = {}
for path in sorted(glob.glob(f'{B}/raw/*.json')):
    for r in json.load(open(path)):
        assert r['id'] not in raw, r['id']
        raw[r['id']] = r

feats = []
section_rejections = collections.defaultdict(list)
for s in sections:
    d = json.load(open(f"{B}/features/{s['id']}.json"))
    for i, f in enumerate(d['features']):
        f['see_also'] = []
        f['merged_from'] = []
        f['_seq'] = (page_rank.get(f['page'], 10**6), len(feats))
        feats.append(f)
    for r in d['rejected']:
        section_rejections[r['raw_id']].append((s['id'], r['reason']))
start_count = len(feats)
start_claimed = {i for f in feats for i in f['raw_ids']}
orphans_found = sorted(set(raw) - start_claimed)

# Integrity first: two sections used one id for the one record.
seen = {}
renamed = []
for f in feats:
    if f['id'] in seen:
        new = f"{f['id']}-{f['page'].split('/')[0]}"
        renamed.append((f['id'], new, f['page']))
        f['id'] = new
    seen[f['id']] = f
by_id = seen

problems = []


def F(i):
    if i not in by_id:
        problems.append(f'decision names unknown feature {i}')
        return None
    return by_id[i]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- orphans

for rid, (fid, why) in ABSORB.items():
    f = F(fid)
    if f and rid not in f['raw_ids']:
        f['raw_ids'].append(rid)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- merges

alias = {}
merge_log = []
for keep, drop, why in MERGES:
    k, d = F(keep), F(drop)
    if not k or not d:
        continue
    for field in ('raw_ids', 'ui', 'shortcuts', 'mcp', 'code_refs'):
        add_unique(k[field], d[field])
    req = list(k['requires'])
    add_unique(req, d['requires'])
    k['requires'] = [x for x in req if x != 'none'] or req
    kt = toks(k['summary'] + ' ' + ' '.join(k['details']))
    if len(toks(d['summary']) - kt) > 1:
        add_unique(k['details'], [d['summary']])
    have = {norm(x) for x in k['details']}
    for x in d['details']:
        if norm(x) not in have:
            k['details'].append(x)
            have.add(norm(x))
    if not k['guide_ref']:
        k['guide_ref'] = d['guide_ref']
    if d['page'] != k['page']:
        add_unique(k['see_also'], [d['page']])
    add_unique(k['see_also'], [x for x in d['see_also'] if x != k['page']])
    add_unique(k['merged_from'], [drop] + d['merged_from'])
    alias[drop] = keep
    merge_log.append((keep, k['page'], drop, d['page'], why))
    feats.remove(d)
    del by_id[drop]


def resolve(i):
    while i in alias:
        i = alias[i]
    return i


def link(a, b):
    if a['page'] != b['page']:
        add_unique(a['see_also'], [b['page']])
        add_unique(b['see_also'], [a['page']])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mirrors, links

mirror_log = collections.Counter()
for sec, owner, cls in MIRRORS:
    a, b = F(resolve(sec)), F(resolve(owner))
    if a and b:
        a['mirror_of'] = b['id']
        link(a, b)
        mirror_log[cls] += 1
for x, y in LINKS:
    a, b = F(resolve(x)), F(resolve(y))
    if a and b:
        link(a, b)

# Tool catalogue: each tool's row on mcp/tools-* defers to the entry that owns it.
tools = sorted({t for f in feats for t in f['mcp']})
tool_rows = 0
tool_no_owner = []
tool_notes = 0
for T in tools:
    C = by_id.get('mcp-tool-' + T.replace('_', '-'))
    if C is None:
        problems.append(f'no catalogue row for {T}')
        continue
    owner = None
    if T in TOOL_OWNER:
        owner = TOOL_OWNER[T] and F(resolve(TOOL_OWNER[T]))
    else:
        best = (0, None)
        cr = set(C['raw_ids'])
        for f in feats:
            if f['page'].startswith(('mcp/', 'reference/')) or T not in f['mcp']:
                continue
            sc = sim(norm(f['name']), norm(T)) + .4 * min(len(cr & set(f['raw_ids'])), 2)
            sc += (.3 if f['mcp'][0] == T else 0) + (.2 if len(f['mcp']) == 1 else 0)
            if any(norm(re.split('▸', u)[-1]) == norm(f['name']) for u in f['ui']):
                sc += .4
            if T in f['name']:
                sc -= .3
            if sc > best[0]:
                best = (sc, f)
        owner = best[1]
    if owner is None:
        tool_no_owner.append(T)
    else:
        C['mirror_of'] = owner['id']
        link(C, owner)
        tool_rows += 1
    if '_' in T:
        for f in feats:
            if f is C or f is owner or f['page'].startswith(('mcp/', 'reference/')):
                continue
            if T in f['mcp'] and T in f['name']:
                link(f, C)
                tool_notes += 1
                if norm(f['name']) in {norm(T), norm(f'{T} tool'), norm(f'{T} for agents'), norm(f'{T} (agents)')}:
                    f['mirror_of'] = C['id']
for x, y in DEEP_LINKS:
    a, b = F(resolve(x)), F(resolve(y))
    if a and b:
        link(a, b)

# Same name, same source record, one side a reference or tool page: link.
claimed = collections.defaultdict(list)
for f in feats:
    for r in f['raw_ids']:
        claimed[r].append(f)
ref_links = 0
for r, l in claimed.items():
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(l, 2):
        if a['page'] == b['page'] or norm(a['name']) != norm(b['name']):
            continue
        if a['page'].split('/')[0] in ('mcp', 'reference') or b['page'].split('/')[0] in ('mcp', 'reference'):
            if b['page'] not in a['see_also']:
                ref_links += 1
            link(a, b)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- text

text_fixes = []
for fid, rules in DETAIL_FIXES.items():
    f = F(resolve(fid))
    if not f:
        continue
    out = []
    for d in f['details']:
        new = d
        for pat, rep in rules:
            if re.search(pat, new):
                new = None if rep is None else re.sub(pat, rep, new)
                if new is None:
                    break
        if new != d:
            text_fixes.append(f['id'])
        if new is not None:
            out.append(new)
    f['details'] = out
spec_fixes = []
for f in feats:
    for key in ('summary',):
        if SPEC.search(f[key]):
            spec_fixes.append((f['id'], f[key]))
            f[key] = SPEC.sub('', f[key]).strip()
    new = []
    for d in f['details']:
        if SPEC.search(d):
            spec_fixes.append((f['id'], d))
            d = SPEC.sub('', d).strip()
        new.append(d)
    f['details'] = new

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- taxonomy

tax_log = []
for slug, old, new, why in TAXONOMY_FIXES:
    p = pages[slug][1]
    if old in p['scope']:
        p['scope'] = p['scope'].replace(old, new)
        tax_log.append((slug, why))
    elif new in p['scope']:
        tax_log.append((slug, why))
    else:
        problems.append(f'taxonomy fix for {slug} matches nothing')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- verify

claimed_ids = {i for f in feats for i in f['raw_ids']}
rejected_final = {}
for rid in sorted(set(raw) - claimed_ids):
    if rid in REJECT:
        rejected_final[rid] = REJECT[rid]
    else:
        problems.append(f'orphan {rid}: {raw[rid]["name"]}')
for rid in REJECT:
    if rid in claimed_ids:
        problems.append(f'{rid} is both rejected and claimed')
for f in feats:
    for i in f['raw_ids']:
        if i not in raw:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} claims unknown raw {i}")

ids = collections.Counter(f['id'] for f in feats)
problems += [f'duplicate feature id {k}' for k, v in ids.items() if v > 1]
for f in feats:
    if f['page'] not in pages:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} on unknown page {f['page']}")
    for s in f['see_also']:
        if s not in pages:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} see_also unknown page {s}")
        if s == f['page']:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} see_also its own page")
    if 'mirror_of' in f and f['mirror_of'] not in by_id:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mirror_of unknown {f['mirror_of']}")
    if 'mirror_of' in f and f['mirror_of'] == f['id']:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mirrors itself")
per_page = collections.Counter(f['page'] for f in feats)
for slug, (s, p) in pages.items():
    if per_page[slug] == 0:
        problems.append(f"page {slug} ({p['kind']}) has no feature")

for f in feats:
    body = json.dumps({k: v for k, v in f.items() if k not in ('raw_ids', '_seq')}, ensure_ascii=False)
    m = DEV.search(body)
    if m:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mentions dev-only {m.group(0)}")
    m = re.search(r'spec §|road map|taxonomy|page scope', json.dumps({k: f[k] for k in ('name', 'summary', 'details')}, ensure_ascii=False), re.I)
    if m:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} carries an author note: {m.group(0)}")

# Duplicate detector over what is left: every flagged pair must be linked or
# listed as distinct.
distinct = {frozenset(p): why for why, l in DISTINCT.items() for p in l}
shared = collections.Counter()
for r, l in claimed.items():
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(sorted({f['id'] for f in l if f['id'] in by_id}), 2):
        shared[(a, b)] += 1
T = {f['id']: toks(f['summary']) for f in feats}
N = {f['id']: norm(f['name']) for f in feats}
U = {f['id']: {norm(u) for u in f['ui']} - GENERIC_UI for f in feats}
flagged = []
for a, b in itertools.combinations(feats, 2):
    if a['page'] == b['page']:
        continue
    x, y = a['id'], b['id']
    n = shared.get((x, y), 0) + shared.get((y, x), 0)
    same = N[x] == N[y]
    j = jac(T[x], T[y])
    uis = U[x] & U[y]
    hit = False
    if same and (n or j >= .3 or (uis and j >= .15)):
        hit = True
    elif n and j >= .4:
        hit = True
    elif j >= .7 and len(T[x]) >= 5:
        hit = True
    elif n and sim(N[x], N[y]) >= .8:
        hit = True
    if not hit:
        continue
    if b['page'] in a['see_also'] or a['page'] in b['see_also']:
        continue
    if frozenset((x, y)) in distinct:
        continue
    flagged.append((x, a['page'], a['name'], y, b['page'], b['name'], n, round(j, 2)))
for row in flagged:
    problems.append('unresolved duplicate: %s [%s] "%s" <> %s [%s] "%s" raw=%d j=%s' % row)

if problems:
    print(f'{len(problems)} problems')
    for p in problems:
        print(' ', p)
    sys.exit(1)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- write

feats.sort(key=lambda f: (page_rank[f['page']], f['_seq'][1]))
out = []
for f in feats:
    g = {k: f[k] for k in ('id', 'name', 'page', 'anchor', 'summary', 'ui', 'shortcuts', 'mcp', 'requires', 'details', 'raw_ids', 'guide_ref', 'code_refs', 'see_also')}
    g['see_also'] = sorted(g['see_also'], key=lambda s: page_rank[s])
    if f.get('mirror_of'):
        g['mirror_of'] = f['mirror_of']
    if f['merged_from']:
        g['merged_from'] = f['merged_from']
    out.append(g)
json.dump({'features': out}, open(f'{B}/features.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
json.dump(taxonomy, open(f'{B}/taxonomy.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
json.dump({'rejected': [{'raw_id': k, 'name': raw[k]['name'], 'reason': v} for k, v in rejected_final.items()]},
          open(f'{B}/rejected.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

W = []
W.append('# Feature inventory audit\n')
W.append(f'{len(raw)} raw records, {len(out)} features on {len(pages)} pages in {len(sections)} sections. '
         f'Started from {start_count} features. Every check in `audit.py` passes.\n')
W.append('## Counts per section\n')
W.append('| Section | Pages | Features | Mirrors | With see_also |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|')
for s in sorted(sections, key=lambda s: s['order']):
    fs = [f for f in out if pages[f['page']][0] is s]
    W.append(f"| {s['title']} | {len(s['pages'])} | {len(fs)} | {sum(1 for f in fs if 'mirror_of' in f)} | {sum(1 for f in fs if f['see_also'])} |")
W.append(f"| **Total** | **{len(pages)}** | **{len(out)}** | **{sum(1 for f in out if 'mirror_of' in f)}** | **{sum(1 for f in out if f['see_also'])}** |\n")
W.append('## Orphans\n')
W.append(f'{len(orphans_found)} raw records had no feature; each had been passed to a section that never took it, or rejected. {len(ABSORB)} absorbed, {len(rejected_final)} rejected, 0 left.\n')
for rid, (fid, why) in ABSORB.items():
    W.append(f'- `{rid}` "{raw[rid]["name"]}" absorbed into `{fid}`: {why}.')
W.append('')
W.append('## Records rejected\n')
W.append(f'One reason, one record. The other {sum(len(v) for v in section_rejections.values()) - 1} section-level rejections were "belongs to X" or a duplicate note on records another section does claim, so none of them removes anything.\n')
for k, v in rejected_final.items():
    W.append(f'- `{k}` "{raw[k]["name"]}": {v}')
W.append('')
W.append('## Duplicates merged\n')
W.append(f'{len(merge_log)} entries folded into the entry on the primary page. The kept entry takes the raw ids, details, ui and tools, lists the other page in `see_also` and the dropped id in `merged_from`.\n')
W.append('| Kept | Page | Dropped | From | Why this page |\n|---|---|---|---|---|')
for keep, kp, drop, dp, why in merge_log:
    W.append(f'| `{keep}` | {kp} | `{drop}` | {dp} | {why} |')
W.append('')
W.append('## Two entries kept on purpose\n')
W.append(f"Some pages exist to list things other pages own, so deleting the row would break the page's scope. These stay, carry `mirror_of` naming the owning entry, and link both ways by `see_also`. A page writer should keep a mirror to a line and a link.\n")
for k, v in mirror_log.most_common():
    W.append(f'- {k}: {v}')
W.append(f'- MCP tool catalogue rows on `mcp/tools-*`: {tool_rows} of {len(tools)} defer to an owner. {len(tool_no_owner)} have no single UI home and stand alone: {", ".join("`" + t + "`" for t in tool_no_owner)}.')
W.append(f'- Tool notes on feature pages linked to their catalogue row: {tool_notes}.')
W.append(f'- Same-name pairs on a reference or tool page sharing a source record, linked: {ref_links}.')
W.append(f'- A general rule and its case, linked only: {len(LINKS)}.\n')
W.append('`mcp[0]` alone is not a duplicate signal: 240 features start with `set_video` because each is one of its patch keys. "Same tool as primary" was read as the entry that is about the tool. "Same ui path" likewise: sub-controls of one sheet share a path, so the check is on the entry the path\'s last segment names.\n')
W.append('## Other changes\n')
for old, new, page in renamed:
    W.append(f'- Duplicate id `{old}` on {page} renamed `{new}` before merging.')
for slug, why in tax_log:
    W.append(f'- `taxonomy.json`, {slug} scope corrected: {why}.')
W.append(f'- Author notes aimed at the taxonomy or the record rewritten as the fact, on: {", ".join("`" + x + "`" for x in sorted(set(text_fixes)))}.')
if spec_fixes:
    W.append(f'- Spec or road map citations stripped from {len(spec_fixes)} text fields.')
W.append('- No page was added, merged or removed: every page has at least one feature.\n')
W.append('## Checks\n')
W.append('- Every raw id is in a feature or in `rejected.json`; no id is in both.\n- Feature ids unique; every page and `see_also` in the taxonomy; `mirror_of` resolves.\n- No feature mentions the dev tools, a dev tool by name, or an `-RCDev` default. No raw record did either.\n- All 125 MCP tools appear; no name outside the catalogue.\n- The duplicate detector reports nothing unlinked and unlisted.\n')
W.append('## For the page writers\n')
n_code = sum(1 for f in out for d in f['details'] if re.match(r'(Code (note|check|wins|over)|Code:)', d))
W.append(f'- {n_code} details start "Code note", "Code check" or similar: the code disagrees with the guide or fills a gap in it. They are correct facts in author voice; write the fact, not the note. Some mean `docs/guide/` is out of date.')
W.append(f"- {sum(1 for f in out if not f['raw_ids'])} features have no raw record (the install page, core concepts, the glossary, two assistant rows). They were written from `code_refs` and the guide, so they are not orphans, but no sweep found them.")
W.append('- Anchors repeat on purpose where several entries sit under one heading; they are headings, not feature keys.\n')
open(f'{B}/audit.md', 'w').write('\n'.join(W))
print('clean', len(out), 'features', len(pages), 'pages', 'merged', len(merge_log), 'orphans', len(orphans_found), 'rejected', len(rejected_final), 'no-owner', tool_no_owner, 'spec', spec_fixes[:6])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The Frame Job feature inventory audit.

Reads raw/*.json, features/*.json and taxonomy.json beside this file, applies
the decisions below (each one reviewed by hand), proves the result clean, and
writes features.json, rejected.json, taxonomy.json and audit.md. It is
idempotent: taxonomy edits are exact-string replacements that no-op once made.
Exit status 1 means a check failed; nothing is written then.
"""
import collections
import difflib
import glob
import itertools
import json
import os
import re
import sys

B = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- decisions

# Orphans: raw id -> feature that takes it. In each case the feature already
# states the record's facts; only the claim was missing.
ABSORB = {
    'code-history-146': ('background-media-caches', 'audio rejected it as "belongs to projects" and projects never claimed it; this feature already says waveform, loudness and voice detection are built on arrival and cached'),
    'guide-canvas-and-layers-121': ('hide-while-silent', 'framing rejected it as "belongs to effects" and effects never claimed it; this feature\'s details already carry all three of its facts'),
    'guide-projects-and-media-129': ('editing-drops-that-spring-back', 'projects rejected it as "belongs to editing" and editing never claimed it; this feature already says a row is refused in another project\'s window'),
    'guide-projects-and-media-130': ('editing-new-clips-cover-the-file', 'three sections each passed it to another and none claimed it; this feature already says a clip is the whole file and a picture 5 seconds'),
}
REJECT = {
    'code-history-636': 'Not built. Spotlight has no Place on Canvas button and no canvas mode: CanvasRegionPurpose has only zoom and obscure (CanvasSessions.swift:902), every "Place on Canvas" in app/Sources is the Obscure section\'s, and the cited VideoPane.swift:63 is a comment about the Obscure list.',
}

# Same feature on two pages: (keep, drop, why this page is primary).
MERGES = [
    ('edit-slip-roll-actions', 'editing-slip-roll-actions', 'motion/how-edits-move-actions is the page that answers what each edit does to actions'),
    ('edit-trim-actions', 'editing-trim-and-actions', 'same page rule: what a trim does to actions'),
    ('edit-copies-actions', 'editing-what-a-copy-keeps', 'same page rule, and this entry names Duplicate, Copy and Paste'),
    ('edit-speed-actions', 'speed-actions-keep-place', 'same page rule: what a speed change does to actions'),
    ('action-stale-rows', 'graphics-action-stale-rows', 'the scope of motion/how-edits-move-actions names stale rows'),
    ('animate-text', 'text-animate-with-actions', 'motion/what-can-animate lists Text; text-style\'s scope does not mention actions'),
    ('graphics-animate-false', 'graphic-props-not-animated', 'graphics/animate-properties names the animate: false flag'),
    ('graphics-animated-start-values', 'graphic-animation-values', 'graphics/animate-properties owns graphic props in actions; its range check stays a sibling entry'),
    ('color-animate-curves', 'action-curves-animate', 'color/animate-a-grade names curves of different point counts'),
    ('graphics-transition-handles', 'transition-graphic-handles', 'it is a rule of the graphic\'s own timeline, which graphics/size-and-timing owns'),
    ('speed-reverse-depth-colour', 'reversed-clips-depth', 'speed/reverse names depth and colour kept'),
    ('graphics-vertical-resized', 'vertical-graphics-resized', 'graphics/vertical-graphics names re-sizing; framing/vertical-what-changes only lists it'),
    ('graphics-vertical-older-copies', 'vertical-templates-updated', 'graphics/vertical-graphics names older bundled copies'),
    ('graphics-vertical-own-modules', 'vertical-height-modules-named', 'graphics/vertical-graphics names height-sized modules'),
    ('graphics-vertical-short-side', 'vertical-templates-short-side', 'graphics/vertical-graphics is how graphics lay out on a tall canvas'),
    ('color-adjustment-no-transition', 'transition-adjustment-clips', 'color/adjustment-clips names the limit'),
    ('color-adjustment-no-nest', 'editing-adjustment-clips-and-nests', 'color/adjustment-clips names the limit'),
    ('color-adjustment-graphics', 'graphics-no-color-sub-tab', 'grading through an adjustment clip is that page\'s subject'),
    ('filters-on-adjustment-clips', 'color-adjustment-point-filters', 'effects/filters names which filters an adjustment clip takes'),
    ('matte-adjustment-clip', 'color-adjustment-matte', 'canvas/matte-tracks names it and this entry also covers a clip on a matte track'),
    ('color-lut-warn-hlg', 'cube-look-in-hdr', 'the warning is the Look section\'s, on color/luts'),
    ('log-lut-converts-twice', 'color-lut-warn-camera-log', 'hdr/log-luts names converting twice and this entry gives the order'),
    ('qualifiers-across-a-switch', 'color-qualifier-hdr', 'hdr/dynamic-range names qualifiers across a switch'),
    ('edit-revealed-speech-uncaptioned', 'speed-captions-new-speech', 'captions/edit-captions names newly revealed speech'),
    ('transition-overlap-rules', 'editing-overlap-rule', 'an overlap is a transition, so motion/transitions owns the rule'),
    ('timeline-markers-in-a-nest', 'editing-markers-inside-a-nest', 'timeline/markers names markers while a nest is open'),
    ('timeline-lock-track', 'editing-locked-tracks', 'timeline/hide-and-lock-tracks names what a lock protects'),
    ('timeline-new-track-by-drop', 'editing-move-onto-a-new-track', 'timeline/manage-tracks names dropping past the stack'),
    ('timeline-snap-toggle', 'canvas-snap-toggle', 'timeline/snapping names the box and N; canvas/canvas-snapping does not'),
    ('cleanup-voiceless-clips', 'cleanup-silence-note-level', 'cleanup/voice-or-level names voiceless clips'),
    ('cleanup-transitions-protected', 'transition-cleanup-limit', 'cleanup/how-cleanup-cuts-work names what the cuts protect'),
    ('editing-split-graphics', 'graphics-split', 'editing/splitting names what happens to graphics'),
    ('audio-detached-actions-and-ramps', 'edit-detach-actions', 'audio/detach-and-attach names a detached sound with actions or a ramp'),
    ('audio-detached-actions-and-ramps', 'speed-detach-keeps-ramp', 'same'),
    ('export-colour-labels', 'export-colour-labels-hdr', 'export/what-an-export-includes names colour labels'),
    ('matte-transitions', 'transition-nested-halves', 'canvas/mattes-in-nests names transitions across matted tracks'),
    ('blend-during-transition', 'transition-blend-limit', 'canvas/blend-modes names blend during a transition'),
    ('consolidate-cursor-files', 'rec-cursor-consolidate', 'projects/consolidate-media lists the files it copies'),
    ('color-filters-around-grade', 'filters-around-the-grade', 'color/color-tab names the fixed grade order'),
    ('color-scopes-follow-preview', 'hdr-scopes-follow-the-frame', 'color/scopes names scopes following the preview'),
    ('fit-new-clips-to-canvas', 'editing-new-clips-fit-the-canvas', 'the setting lives on projects/background-and-timecode'),
    ('gs-mixed-values', 'color-mixed-badge', 'getting-started/inspector-fields names the mixed-value badge for every tab'),
    ('action-band-by-track-height', 'timeline-bands-by-height', 'motion/action-lane names bands by track height'),
    ('export-save-frame-deep', 'deep-frames', 'export/save-frame names deep and HDR frames'),
    ('gs-clip-tab-pinned-block', 'clip-tab-pinned-block', 'getting-started/inspector names the pinned block'),
    ('graphics-copy-a-clip', 'editing-paste-a-graphic-clip', 'what a graphic clip carries is the graphics section\'s to say'),
]

# A short restatement that a page's scope requires it to keep, deferring to the
# entry that owns the feature: (restatement, owner, page class).
MIRRORS = [
    ('timeline-clip-transition-zone', 'transition-zone', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-volume-line', 'audio-volume-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-rate-line', 'speed-rate-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-motion-marks', 'motion-timeline-marks', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-link-marks', 'audio-linked-marks', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-label-dot', 'timeline-clip-labels', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-gate-line', 'hide-while-silent-timeline-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-duck-line', 'audio-duck-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-cached-drawings', 'background-media-caches', 'legend'),
    ('audio-clip-waveforms', 'timeline-clip-waveform', 'overview'),
    ('gs-concept-actions', 'action-overview', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-concept-frame-grid', 'editing-times-land-on-frames', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-concept-clips-never-push', 'editing-clips-never-push', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-refused-drop', 'editing-refused-drop', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-autosave-keeps-your-work', 'autosave-in-place', 'getting started'),
    ('gs-preview-pane', 'timeline-preview-pane', 'getting started'),
    ('framing-analysis-on-demand', 'analysis-on-demand', 'concept'),
    ('framing-analysis-background', 'analysis-in-the-background', 'concept'),
    ('framing-found-faces', 'face-analysis', 'concept'),
    ('framing-found-salient', 'subject-analysis', 'concept'),
    ('assistant-can-graphics', 'graphics-assistant', 'assistant list'),
    ('assistant-cut-false-starts', 'cleanup-false-starts', 'assistant list'),
    ('assistant-cut-filler-words', 'cleanup-assistant-fillers-silences', 'assistant list'),
    ('animate-graphic-properties', 'graphics-animate-with-an-action', 'reference'),
    ('audio-trim-sound-alone', 'editing-sound-clip-alone', 'how-to'),
    ('hdr-frames', 'export-save-frame-deep', 'scope names it'),
    ('image-clip-starting-size', 'fit-new-clips-to-canvas', 'scope names it'),
    ('line-arrowheads-howto', 'shape-arrowheads', 'how-to'),
    ('speed-remove-action', 'remove-action', 'how-to'),

# Pairs the duplicate detector flags that were read and are different things.
# One reason per class; a pair matches by its two ids.
DISTINCT = {
    'different key or service': [('assemblyai-key-environment', 'assistant-env-key'), ('assemblyai-key-storage', 'assistant-key-file'), ('assemblyai-key-remove', 'assistant-remove-key'), ('assemblyai-key-field', 'assistant-save-key')],

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

STOP = set('the a an of to and or in on at is it its for with as by that this be are from your you can when not no one each so if which into than then only'.split())
DEV_NAMES = 'snapshot_ui perform_menu_item cancel_sheet select_inspector_tab play_preview graphic_memory loudness_meter land_recording analysis_job transcript_view playback_rebuilds assistant_send assistant_answer'.split()
DEV = re.compile(r'RCDev|\bdev[- ]tools?\b|dev-only|DEV_TOOLS|' + '|'.join(DEV_NAMES), re.I)
SPEC = re.compile(r'\s*\((?:road map[^)]*|spec §[^)]*)\)|\bspec §\s*[\d.]+[a-z]*(?: [A-Z]+-\d+)?', re.I)
GENERIC_UI = {'timeline', 'automatic', 'preview', 'preview canvas', 'edit undo', 'edit redo'}


def norm(s):
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s.lower()).strip()
    return re.sub(r'^(the|a|an) ', '', s)


def toks(s):
    return {w for w in re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_]+', s.lower()) if w not in STOP}


def sim(a, b):
    return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio()


def jac(a, b):
    return len(a & b) / max(1, len(a | b))


def add_unique(dst, src):
    for x in src:
        if x not in dst:
            dst.append(x)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load

taxonomy = json.load(open(f'{B}/taxonomy.json'))
sections = taxonomy['sections']
pages = {}
page_rank = {}
for s in sorted(sections, key=lambda s: s['order']):
    for p in sorted(s['pages'], key=lambda p: p['order']):
        pages[p['slug']] = (s, p)
        page_rank[p['slug']] = len(page_rank)

raw = {}
for path in sorted(glob.glob(f'{B}/raw/*.json')):
    for r in json.load(open(path)):
        assert r['id'] not in raw, r['id']
        raw[r['id']] = r

feats = []
section_rejections = collections.defaultdict(list)
for s in sections:
    d = json.load(open(f"{B}/features/{s['id']}.json"))
    for i, f in enumerate(d['features']):
        f['see_also'] = []
        f['merged_from'] = []
        f['_seq'] = (page_rank.get(f['page'], 10**6), len(feats))
        feats.append(f)
    for r in d['rejected']:
        section_rejections[r['raw_id']].append((s['id'], r['reason']))
start_count = len(feats)
start_claimed = {i for f in feats for i in f['raw_ids']}
orphans_found = sorted(set(raw) - start_claimed)

# Integrity first: two sections used one id for the one record.
seen = {}
renamed = []
for f in feats:
    if f['id'] in seen:
        new = f"{f['id']}-{f['page'].split('/')[0]}"
        renamed.append((f['id'], new, f['page']))
        f['id'] = new
    seen[f['id']] = f
by_id = seen

problems = []


def F(i):
    if i not in by_id:
        problems.append(f'decision names unknown feature {i}')
        return None
    return by_id[i]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- orphans

for rid, (fid, why) in ABSORB.items():
    f = F(fid)
    if f and rid not in f['raw_ids']:
        f['raw_ids'].append(rid)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- merges

alias = {}
merge_log = []
for keep, drop, why in MERGES:
    k, d = F(keep), F(drop)
    if not k or not d:
        continue
    for field in ('raw_ids', 'ui', 'shortcuts', 'mcp', 'code_refs'):
        add_unique(k[field], d[field])
    req = list(k['requires'])
    add_unique(req, d['requires'])
    k['requires'] = [x for x in req if x != 'none'] or req
    kt = toks(k['summary'] + ' ' + ' '.join(k['details']))
    if len(toks(d['summary']) - kt) > 1:
        add_unique(k['details'], [d['summary']])
    have = {norm(x) for x in k['details']}
    for x in d['details']:
        if norm(x) not in have:
            k['details'].append(x)
            have.add(norm(x))
    if not k['guide_ref']:
        k['guide_ref'] = d['guide_ref']
    if d['page'] != k['page']:
        add_unique(k['see_also'], [d['page']])
    add_unique(k['see_also'], [x for x in d['see_also'] if x != k['page']])
    add_unique(k['merged_from'], [drop] + d['merged_from'])
    alias[drop] = keep
    merge_log.append((keep, k['page'], drop, d['page'], why))
    feats.remove(d)
    del by_id[drop]


def resolve(i):
    while i in alias:
        i = alias[i]
    return i


def link(a, b):
    if a['page'] != b['page']:
        add_unique(a['see_also'], [b['page']])
        add_unique(b['see_also'], [a['page']])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mirrors, links

mirror_log = collections.Counter()
for sec, owner, cls in MIRRORS:
    a, b = F(resolve(sec)), F(resolve(owner))
    if a and b:
        a['mirror_of'] = b['id']
        link(a, b)
        mirror_log[cls] += 1
for x, y in LINKS:
    a, b = F(resolve(x)), F(resolve(y))
    if a and b:
        link(a, b)

# Tool catalogue: each tool's row on mcp/tools-* defers to the entry that owns it.
tools = sorted({t for f in feats for t in f['mcp']})
tool_rows = 0
tool_no_owner = []
tool_notes = 0
for T in tools:
    C = by_id.get('mcp-tool-' + T.replace('_', '-'))
    if C is None:
        problems.append(f'no catalogue row for {T}')
        continue
    owner = None
    if T in TOOL_OWNER:
        owner = TOOL_OWNER[T] and F(resolve(TOOL_OWNER[T]))
    else:
        best = (0, None)
        cr = set(C['raw_ids'])
        for f in feats:
            if f['page'].startswith(('mcp/', 'reference/')) or T not in f['mcp']:
                continue
            sc = sim(norm(f['name']), norm(T)) + .4 * min(len(cr & set(f['raw_ids'])), 2)
            sc += (.3 if f['mcp'][0] == T else 0) + (.2 if len(f['mcp']) == 1 else 0)
            if any(norm(re.split('▸', u)[-1]) == norm(f['name']) for u in f['ui']):
                sc += .4
            if T in f['name']:
                sc -= .3
            if sc > best[0]:
                best = (sc, f)
        owner = best[1]
    if owner is None:
        tool_no_owner.append(T)
    else:
        C['mirror_of'] = owner['id']
        link(C, owner)
        tool_rows += 1
    if '_' in T:
        for f in feats:
            if f is C or f is owner or f['page'].startswith(('mcp/', 'reference/')):
                continue
            if T in f['mcp'] and T in f['name']:
                link(f, C)
                tool_notes += 1
                if norm(f['name']) in {norm(T), norm(f'{T} tool'), norm(f'{T} for agents'), norm(f'{T} (agents)')}:
                    f['mirror_of'] = C['id']
for x, y in DEEP_LINKS:
    a, b = F(resolve(x)), F(resolve(y))
    if a and b:
        link(a, b)

# Same name, same source record, one side a reference or tool page: link.
claimed = collections.defaultdict(list)
for f in feats:
    for r in f['raw_ids']:
        claimed[r].append(f)
ref_links = 0
for r, l in claimed.items():
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(l, 2):
        if a['page'] == b['page'] or norm(a['name']) != norm(b['name']):
            continue
        if a['page'].split('/')[0] in ('mcp', 'reference') or b['page'].split('/')[0] in ('mcp', 'reference'):
            if b['page'] not in a['see_also']:
                ref_links += 1
            link(a, b)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- text

text_fixes = []
for fid, rules in DETAIL_FIXES.items():
    f = F(resolve(fid))
    if not f:
        continue
    out = []
    for d in f['details']:
        new = d
        for pat, rep in rules:
            if re.search(pat, new):
                new = None if rep is None else re.sub(pat, rep, new)
                if new is None:
                    break
        if new != d:
            text_fixes.append(f['id'])
        if new is not None:
            out.append(new)
    f['details'] = out
spec_fixes = []
for f in feats:
    for key in ('summary',):
        if SPEC.search(f[key]):
            spec_fixes.append((f['id'], f[key]))
            f[key] = SPEC.sub('', f[key]).strip()
    new = []
    for d in f['details']:
        if SPEC.search(d):
            spec_fixes.append((f['id'], d))
            d = SPEC.sub('', d).strip()
        new.append(d)
    f['details'] = new

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- taxonomy

tax_log = []
for slug, old, new, why in TAXONOMY_FIXES:
    p = pages[slug][1]
    if old in p['scope']:
        p['scope'] = p['scope'].replace(old, new)
        tax_log.append((slug, why))
    elif new in p['scope']:
        tax_log.append((slug, why))
    else:
        problems.append(f'taxonomy fix for {slug} matches nothing')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- verify

claimed_ids = {i for f in feats for i in f['raw_ids']}
rejected_final = {}
for rid in sorted(set(raw) - claimed_ids):
    if rid in REJECT:
        rejected_final[rid] = REJECT[rid]
    else:
        problems.append(f'orphan {rid}: {raw[rid]["name"]}')
for rid in REJECT:
    if rid in claimed_ids:
        problems.append(f'{rid} is both rejected and claimed')
for f in feats:
    for i in f['raw_ids']:
        if i not in raw:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} claims unknown raw {i}")

ids = collections.Counter(f['id'] for f in feats)
problems += [f'duplicate feature id {k}' for k, v in ids.items() if v > 1]
for f in feats:
    if f['page'] not in pages:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} on unknown page {f['page']}")
    for s in f['see_also']:
        if s not in pages:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} see_also unknown page {s}")
        if s == f['page']:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} see_also its own page")
    if 'mirror_of' in f and f['mirror_of'] not in by_id:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mirror_of unknown {f['mirror_of']}")
    if 'mirror_of' in f and f['mirror_of'] == f['id']:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mirrors itself")
per_page = collections.Counter(f['page'] for f in feats)
for slug, (s, p) in pages.items():
    if per_page[slug] == 0:
        problems.append(f"page {slug} ({p['kind']}) has no feature")

for f in feats:
    body = json.dumps({k: v for k, v in f.items() if k not in ('raw_ids', '_seq')}, ensure_ascii=False)
    m = DEV.search(body)
    if m:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mentions dev-only {m.group(0)}")
    m = re.search(r'spec §|road map|taxonomy|page scope', json.dumps({k: f[k] for k in ('name', 'summary', 'details')}, ensure_ascii=False), re.I)
    if m:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} carries an author note: {m.group(0)}")

# Duplicate detector over what is left: every flagged pair must be linked or
# listed as distinct.
distinct = {frozenset(p): why for why, l in DISTINCT.items() for p in l}
shared = collections.Counter()
for r, l in claimed.items():
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(sorted({f['id'] for f in l if f['id'] in by_id}), 2):
        shared[(a, b)] += 1
T = {f['id']: toks(f['summary']) for f in feats}
N = {f['id']: norm(f['name']) for f in feats}
U = {f['id']: {norm(u) for u in f['ui']} - GENERIC_UI for f in feats}
flagged = []
for a, b in itertools.combinations(feats, 2):
    if a['page'] == b['page']:
        continue
    x, y = a['id'], b['id']
    n = shared.get((x, y), 0) + shared.get((y, x), 0)
    same = N[x] == N[y]
    j = jac(T[x], T[y])
    uis = U[x] & U[y]
    hit = False
    if same and (n or j >= .3 or (uis and j >= .15)):
        hit = True
    elif n and j >= .4:
        hit = True
    elif j >= .7 and len(T[x]) >= 5:
        hit = True
    elif n and sim(N[x], N[y]) >= .8:
        hit = True
    if not hit:
        continue
    if b['page'] in a['see_also'] or a['page'] in b['see_also']:
        continue
    if frozenset((x, y)) in distinct:
        continue
    flagged.append((x, a['page'], a['name'], y, b['page'], b['name'], n, round(j, 2)))
for row in flagged:
    problems.append('unresolved duplicate: %s [%s] "%s" <> %s [%s] "%s" raw=%d j=%s' % row)

if problems:
    print(f'{len(problems)} problems')
    for p in problems:
        print(' ', p)
    sys.exit(1)

for f in feats:

json.dump({'features': out}, open(f'{B}/features.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
json.dump(taxonomy, open(f'{B}/taxonomy.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
json.dump({'rejected': [{'raw_id': k, 'name': raw[k]['name'], 'reason': v} for k, v in rejected_final.items()]},
          open(f'{B}/rejected.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

for rid, (fid, why) in ABSORB.items():
    W.append(f'- `{rid}` "{raw[rid]["name"]}" absorbed into `{fid}`: {why}.')
W.append('')
W.append('## Records rejected\n')
W.append(f'One reason, one record. The other {sum(len(v) for v in section_rejections.values()) - 1} section-level rejections were "belongs to X" or a duplicate note on records another section does claim, so none of them removes anything.\n')
for k, v in rejected_final.items():
    W.append(f'- `{k}` "{raw[k]["name"]}": {v}')
W.append('')
W.append('## Duplicates merged\n')
W.append(f'{len(merge_log)} entries folded into the entry on the primary page. The kept entry takes the raw ids, details, ui and tools, lists the other page in `see_also` and the dropped id in `merged_from`.\n')
W.append('| Kept | Page | Dropped | From | Why this page |\n|---|---|---|---|---|')
for keep, kp, drop, dp, why in merge_log:
    W.append(f'| `{keep}` | {kp} | `{drop}` | {dp} | {why} |')
W.append('')
W.append('## Two entries kept on purpose\n')
W.append(f"Some pages exist to list things other pages own, so deleting the row would break the page's scope. These stay, carry `mirror_of` naming the owning entry, and link both ways by `see_also`. A page writer should keep a mirror to a line and a link.\n")
for k, v in mirror_log.most_common():
    W.append(f'- {k}: {v}')
W.append(f'- MCP tool catalogue rows on `mcp/tools-*`: {tool_rows} of {len(tools)} defer to an owner. {len(tool_no_owner)} have no single UI home and stand alone: {", ".join("`" + t + "`" for t in tool_no_owner)}.')
W.append(f'- Tool notes on feature pages linked to their catalogue row: {tool_notes}.')
W.append(f'- Same-name pairs on a reference or tool page sharing a source record, linked: {ref_links}.')
W.append(f'- A general rule and its case, linked only: {len(LINKS)}.\n')
W.append('`mcp[0]` alone is not a duplicate signal: 240 features start with `set_video` because each is one of its patch keys. "Same tool as primary" was read as the entry that is about the tool. "Same ui path" likewise: sub-controls of one sheet share a path, so the check is on the entry the path\'s last segment names.\n')
W.append('## Other changes\n')
for old, new, page in renamed:
    W.append(f'- Duplicate id `{old}` on {page} renamed `{new}` before merging.')
for slug, why in tax_log:
    W.append(f'- `taxonomy.json`, {slug} scope corrected: {why}.')
W.append(f'- Author notes aimed at the taxonomy or the record rewritten as the fact, on: {", ".join("`" + x + "`" for x in sorted(set(text_fixes)))}.')
if spec_fixes:
    W.append(f'- Spec or road map citations stripped from {len(spec_fixes)} text fields.')
W.append('- No page was added, merged or removed: every page has at least one feature.\n')
W.append('## Checks\n')
W.append('- Every raw id is in a feature or in `rejected.json`; no id is in both.\n- Feature ids unique; every page and `see_also` in the taxonomy; `mirror_of` resolves.\n- No feature mentions the dev tools, a dev tool by name, or an `-RCDev` default. No raw record did either.\n- All 125 MCP tools appear; no name outside the catalogue.\n- The duplicate detector reports nothing unlinked and unlisted.\n')
W.append('## For the page writers\n')
n_code = sum(1 for f in out for d in f['details'] if re.match(r'(Code (note|check|wins|over)|Code:)', d))
W.append(f'- {n_code} details start "Code note", "Code check" or similar: the code disagrees with the guide or fills a gap in it. They are correct facts in author voice; write the fact, not the note. Some mean `docs/guide/` is out of date.')
W.append(f"- {sum(1 for f in out if not f['raw_ids'])} features have no raw record (the install page, core concepts, the glossary, two assistant rows). They were written from `code_refs` and the guide, so they are not orphans, but no sweep found them.")
W.append('- Anchors repeat on purpose where several entries sit under one heading; they are headings, not feature keys.\n')
open(f'{B}/audit.md', 'w').write('\n'.join(W))
print('clean', len(out), 'features', len(pages), 'pages', 'merged', len(merge_log), 'orphans', len(orphans_found), 'rejected', len(rejected_final), 'no-owner', tool_no_owner, 'spec', spec_fixes[:6])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The Frame Job feature inventory audit.

Reads raw/*.json, features/*.json and taxonomy.json beside this file, applies
the decisions below (each one reviewed by hand), proves the result clean, and
writes features.json, rejected.json, taxonomy.json and audit.md. It is
idempotent: taxonomy edits are exact-string replacements that no-op once made.
Exit status 1 means a check failed; nothing is written then.
"""
import collections
import difflib
import glob
import itertools
import json
import os
import re
import sys

B = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- decisions

# Orphans: raw id -> feature that takes it. In each case the feature already
# states the record's facts; only the claim was missing.
ABSORB = {
    'code-history-146': ('background-media-caches', 'audio rejected it as "belongs to projects" and projects never claimed it; this feature already says waveform, loudness and voice detection are built on arrival and cached'),
    'guide-canvas-and-layers-121': ('hide-while-silent', 'framing rejected it as "belongs to effects" and effects never claimed it; this feature\'s details already carry all three of its facts'),
    'guide-projects-and-media-129': ('editing-drops-that-spring-back', 'projects rejected it as "belongs to editing" and editing never claimed it; this feature already says a row is refused in another project\'s window'),
    'guide-projects-and-media-130': ('editing-new-clips-cover-the-file', 'three sections each passed it to another and none claimed it; this feature already says a clip is the whole file and a picture 5 seconds'),
}
REJECT = {
    'code-history-636': 'Not built. Spotlight has no Place on Canvas button and no canvas mode: CanvasRegionPurpose has only zoom and obscure (CanvasSessions.swift:902), every "Place on Canvas" in app/Sources is the Obscure section\'s, and the cited VideoPane.swift:63 is a comment about the Obscure list.',
}

# Same feature on two pages: (keep, drop, why this page is primary).
MERGES = [
    ('edit-slip-roll-actions', 'editing-slip-roll-actions', 'motion/how-edits-move-actions is the page that answers what each edit does to actions'),
    ('edit-trim-actions', 'editing-trim-and-actions', 'same page rule: what a trim does to actions'),
    ('edit-copies-actions', 'editing-what-a-copy-keeps', 'same page rule, and this entry names Duplicate, Copy and Paste'),
    ('edit-speed-actions', 'speed-actions-keep-place', 'same page rule: what a speed change does to actions'),
    ('action-stale-rows', 'graphics-action-stale-rows', 'the scope of motion/how-edits-move-actions names stale rows'),
    ('animate-text', 'text-animate-with-actions', 'motion/what-can-animate lists Text; text-style\'s scope does not mention actions'),
    ('graphics-animate-false', 'graphic-props-not-animated', 'graphics/animate-properties names the animate: false flag'),
    ('graphics-animated-start-values', 'graphic-animation-values', 'graphics/animate-properties owns graphic props in actions; its range check stays a sibling entry'),
    ('color-animate-curves', 'action-curves-animate', 'color/animate-a-grade names curves of different point counts'),
    ('graphics-transition-handles', 'transition-graphic-handles', 'it is a rule of the graphic\'s own timeline, which graphics/size-and-timing owns'),
    ('speed-reverse-depth-colour', 'reversed-clips-depth', 'speed/reverse names depth and colour kept'),
    ('graphics-vertical-resized', 'vertical-graphics-resized', 'graphics/vertical-graphics names re-sizing; framing/vertical-what-changes only lists it'),
    ('graphics-vertical-older-copies', 'vertical-templates-updated', 'graphics/vertical-graphics names older bundled copies'),
    ('graphics-vertical-own-modules', 'vertical-height-modules-named', 'graphics/vertical-graphics names height-sized modules'),
    ('graphics-vertical-short-side', 'vertical-templates-short-side', 'graphics/vertical-graphics is how graphics lay out on a tall canvas'),
    ('color-adjustment-no-transition', 'transition-adjustment-clips', 'color/adjustment-clips names the limit'),
    ('color-adjustment-no-nest', 'editing-adjustment-clips-and-nests', 'color/adjustment-clips names the limit'),
    ('color-adjustment-graphics', 'graphics-no-color-sub-tab', 'grading through an adjustment clip is that page\'s subject'),
    ('filters-on-adjustment-clips', 'color-adjustment-point-filters', 'effects/filters names which filters an adjustment clip takes'),
    ('matte-adjustment-clip', 'color-adjustment-matte', 'canvas/matte-tracks names it and this entry also covers a clip on a matte track'),
    ('color-lut-warn-hlg', 'cube-look-in-hdr', 'the warning is the Look section\'s, on color/luts'),
    ('log-lut-converts-twice', 'color-lut-warn-camera-log', 'hdr/log-luts names converting twice and this entry gives the order'),
    ('qualifiers-across-a-switch', 'color-qualifier-hdr', 'hdr/dynamic-range names qualifiers across a switch'),
    ('edit-revealed-speech-uncaptioned', 'speed-captions-new-speech', 'captions/edit-captions names newly revealed speech'),
    ('transition-overlap-rules', 'editing-overlap-rule', 'an overlap is a transition, so motion/transitions owns the rule'),
    ('timeline-markers-in-a-nest', 'editing-markers-inside-a-nest', 'timeline/markers names markers while a nest is open'),
    ('timeline-lock-track', 'editing-locked-tracks', 'timeline/hide-and-lock-tracks names what a lock protects'),
    ('timeline-new-track-by-drop', 'editing-move-onto-a-new-track', 'timeline/manage-tracks names dropping past the stack'),
    ('timeline-snap-toggle', 'canvas-snap-toggle', 'timeline/snapping names the box and N; canvas/canvas-snapping does not'),
    ('cleanup-voiceless-clips', 'cleanup-silence-note-level', 'cleanup/voice-or-level names voiceless clips'),
    ('cleanup-transitions-protected', 'transition-cleanup-limit', 'cleanup/how-cleanup-cuts-work names what the cuts protect'),
    ('editing-split-graphics', 'graphics-split', 'editing/splitting names what happens to graphics'),
    ('audio-detached-actions-and-ramps', 'edit-detach-actions', 'audio/detach-and-attach names a detached sound with actions or a ramp'),
    ('audio-detached-actions-and-ramps', 'speed-detach-keeps-ramp', 'same'),
    ('export-colour-labels', 'export-colour-labels-hdr', 'export/what-an-export-includes names colour labels'),
    ('matte-transitions', 'transition-nested-halves', 'canvas/mattes-in-nests names transitions across matted tracks'),
    ('blend-during-transition', 'transition-blend-limit', 'canvas/blend-modes names blend during a transition'),
    ('consolidate-cursor-files', 'rec-cursor-consolidate', 'projects/consolidate-media lists the files it copies'),
    ('color-filters-around-grade', 'filters-around-the-grade', 'color/color-tab names the fixed grade order'),
    ('color-scopes-follow-preview', 'hdr-scopes-follow-the-frame', 'color/scopes names scopes following the preview'),
    ('fit-new-clips-to-canvas', 'editing-new-clips-fit-the-canvas', 'the setting lives on projects/background-and-timecode'),
    ('gs-mixed-values', 'color-mixed-badge', 'getting-started/inspector-fields names the mixed-value badge for every tab'),
    ('action-band-by-track-height', 'timeline-bands-by-height', 'motion/action-lane names bands by track height'),
    ('export-save-frame-deep', 'deep-frames', 'export/save-frame names deep and HDR frames'),
    ('gs-clip-tab-pinned-block', 'clip-tab-pinned-block', 'getting-started/inspector names the pinned block'),
    ('graphics-copy-a-clip', 'editing-paste-a-graphic-clip', 'what a graphic clip carries is the graphics section\'s to say'),
]

# A short restatement that a page's scope requires it to keep, deferring to the
# entry that owns the feature: (restatement, owner, page class).
MIRRORS = [
    ('timeline-clip-transition-zone', 'transition-zone', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-volume-line', 'audio-volume-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-rate-line', 'speed-rate-line', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-motion-marks', 'motion-timeline-marks', 'legend'),
    ('timeline-clip-link-marks', 'audio-linked-marks', 'legend'),

DISTINCT = {

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

STOP = set('the a an of to and or in on at is it its for with as by that this be are from your you can when not no one each so if which into than then only'.split())
DEV_NAMES = 'snapshot_ui perform_menu_item cancel_sheet select_inspector_tab play_preview graphic_memory loudness_meter land_recording analysis_job transcript_view playback_rebuilds assistant_send assistant_answer'.split()
DEV = re.compile(r'RCDev|\bdev[- ]tools?\b|dev-only|DEV_TOOLS|' + '|'.join(DEV_NAMES), re.I)
SPEC = re.compile(r'\s*\((?:road map[^)]*|spec §[^)]*)\)|\bspec §\s*[\d.]+[a-z]*(?: [A-Z]+-\d+)?', re.I)
GENERIC_UI = {'timeline', 'automatic', 'preview', 'preview canvas', 'edit undo', 'edit redo'}


def norm(s):
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s.lower()).strip()
    return re.sub(r'^(the|a|an) ', '', s)


def toks(s):
    return {w for w in re.findall(r'[a-z0-9_]+', s.lower()) if w not in STOP}


def sim(a, b):
    return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio()


def jac(a, b):
    return len(a & b) / max(1, len(a | b))


def add_unique(dst, src):
    for x in src:
        if x not in dst:
            dst.append(x)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- load

taxonomy = json.load(open(f'{B}/taxonomy.json'))
sections = taxonomy['sections']
pages = {}
page_rank = {}
for s in sorted(sections, key=lambda s: s['order']):
    for p in sorted(s['pages'], key=lambda p: p['order']):
        pages[p['slug']] = (s, p)
        page_rank[p['slug']] = len(page_rank)

raw = {}
for path in sorted(glob.glob(f'{B}/raw/*.json')):
    for r in json.load(open(path)):
        assert r['id'] not in raw, r['id']
        raw[r['id']] = r

feats = []
section_rejections = collections.defaultdict(list)
for s in sections:
    d = json.load(open(f"{B}/features/{s['id']}.json"))
    for i, f in enumerate(d['features']):
        f['see_also'] = []
        f['merged_from'] = []
        f['_seq'] = (page_rank.get(f['page'], 10**6), len(feats))
        feats.append(f)
    for r in d['rejected']:
        section_rejections[r['raw_id']].append((s['id'], r['reason']))
start_count = len(feats)
start_claimed = {i for f in feats for i in f['raw_ids']}
orphans_found = sorted(set(raw) - start_claimed)

# Integrity first: two sections used one id for the one record.
seen = {}
renamed = []
for f in feats:
    if f['id'] in seen:
        new = f"{f['id']}-{f['page'].split('/')[0]}"
        renamed.append((f['id'], new, f['page']))
        f['id'] = new
    seen[f['id']] = f
by_id = seen

problems = []


def F(i):
    if i not in by_id:
        problems.append(f'decision names unknown feature {i}')
        return None
    return by_id[i]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- orphans

for rid, (fid, why) in ABSORB.items():
    f = F(fid)
    if f and rid not in f['raw_ids']:
        f['raw_ids'].append(rid)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- merges

alias = {}
merge_log = []
for keep, drop, why in MERGES:
    k, d = F(keep), F(drop)
    if not k or not d:
        continue
    for field in ('raw_ids', 'ui', 'shortcuts', 'mcp', 'code_refs'):
        add_unique(k[field], d[field])
    req = list(k['requires'])
    add_unique(req, d['requires'])
    k['requires'] = [x for x in req if x != 'none'] or req
    kt = toks(k['summary'] + ' ' + ' '.join(k['details']))
    if len(toks(d['summary']) - kt) > 1:
        add_unique(k['details'], [d['summary']])
    have = {norm(x) for x in k['details']}
    for x in d['details']:
        if norm(x) not in have:
            k['details'].append(x)
            have.add(norm(x))
    if not k['guide_ref']:
        k['guide_ref'] = d['guide_ref']
    if d['page'] != k['page']:
        add_unique(k['see_also'], [d['page']])
    add_unique(k['see_also'], [x for x in d['see_also'] if x != k['page']])
    add_unique(k['merged_from'], [drop] + d['merged_from'])
    alias[drop] = keep
    merge_log.append((keep, k['page'], drop, d['page'], why))
    feats.remove(d)
    del by_id[drop]


def resolve(i):
    while i in alias:
        i = alias[i]
    return i


def link(a, b):
    if a['page'] != b['page']:
        add_unique(a['see_also'], [b['page']])
        add_unique(b['see_also'], [a['page']])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mirrors, links

mirror_log = collections.Counter()
for sec, owner, cls in MIRRORS:
    a, b = F(resolve(sec)), F(resolve(owner))
    if a and b:
        a['mirror_of'] = b['id']
        link(a, b)
        mirror_log[cls] += 1
for x, y in LINKS:
    a, b = F(resolve(x)), F(resolve(y))
    if a and b:
        link(a, b)

# Tool catalogue: each tool's row on mcp/tools-* defers to the entry that owns it.
tools = sorted({t for f in feats for t in f['mcp']})
tool_rows = 0
tool_no_owner = []
tool_notes = 0
for T in tools:
    C = by_id.get('mcp-tool-' + T.replace('_', '-'))
    if C is None:
        problems.append(f'no catalogue row for {T}')
        continue
    owner = None
    if T in TOOL_OWNER:
        owner = TOOL_OWNER[T] and F(resolve(TOOL_OWNER[T]))
    else:
        best = (0, None)
        cr = set(C['raw_ids'])
        for f in feats:
            if f['page'].startswith(('mcp/', 'reference/')) or T not in f['mcp']:
                continue
            sc = sim(norm(f['name']), norm(T)) + .4 * min(len(cr & set(f['raw_ids'])), 2)
            sc += (.3 if f['mcp'][0] == T else 0) + (.2 if len(f['mcp']) == 1 else 0)
            if any(norm(re.split('▸', u)[-1]) == norm(f['name']) for u in f['ui']):
                sc += .4
            if T in f['name']:
                sc -= .3
            if sc > best[0]:
                best = (sc, f)
        owner = best[1]
    if owner is None:
        tool_no_owner.append(T)
    else:
        C['mirror_of'] = owner['id']
        link(C, owner)
        tool_rows += 1
    if '_' in T:
        for f in feats:
            if f is C or f is owner or f['page'].startswith(('mcp/', 'reference/')):
                continue
            if T in f['mcp'] and T in f['name']:
                link(f, C)
                tool_notes += 1
                if norm(f['name']) in {norm(T), norm(f'{T} tool'), norm(f'{T} for agents'), norm(f'{T} (agents)')}:
                    f['mirror_of'] = C['id']
for x, y in DEEP_LINKS:
    a, b = F(resolve(x)), F(resolve(y))
    if a and b:
        link(a, b)

# Same name, same source record, one side a reference or tool page: link.
claimed = collections.defaultdict(list)
for f in feats:
    for r in f['raw_ids']:
        claimed[r].append(f)
ref_links = 0
for r, l in claimed.items():
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(l, 2):
        if a['page'] == b['page'] or norm(a['name']) != norm(b['name']):
            continue
        if a['page'].split('/')[0] in ('mcp', 'reference') or b['page'].split('/')[0] in ('mcp', 'reference'):
            if b['page'] not in a['see_also']:
                ref_links += 1
            link(a, b)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- text

text_fixes = []
for fid, rules in DETAIL_FIXES.items():
    f = F(resolve(fid))
    if not f:
        continue
    out = []
    for d in f['details']:
        new = d
        for pat, rep in rules:
            if re.search(pat, new):
                new = None if rep is None else re.sub(pat, rep, new)
                if new is None:
                    break
        if new != d:
            text_fixes.append(f['id'])
        if new is not None:
            out.append(new)
    f['details'] = out
spec_fixes = []
for f in feats:
    for key in ('summary',):
        if SPEC.search(f[key]):
            spec_fixes.append((f['id'], f[key]))
            f[key] = SPEC.sub('', f[key]).strip()
    new = []
    for d in f['details']:
        if SPEC.search(d):
            spec_fixes.append((f['id'], d))
            d = SPEC.sub('', d).strip()
        new.append(d)
    f['details'] = new

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- taxonomy

tax_log = []
for slug, old, new, why in TAXONOMY_FIXES:
    p = pages[slug][1]
    if old in p['scope']:
        p['scope'] = p['scope'].replace(old, new)
        tax_log.append((slug, why))
    elif new in p['scope']:
        tax_log.append((slug, why))
    else:
        problems.append(f'taxonomy fix for {slug} matches nothing')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- verify

claimed_ids = {i for f in feats for i in f['raw_ids']}
rejected_final = {}
for rid in sorted(set(raw) - claimed_ids):
    if rid in REJECT:
        rejected_final[rid] = REJECT[rid]
    else:
        problems.append(f'orphan {rid}: {raw[rid]["name"]}')
for rid in REJECT:
    if rid in claimed_ids:
        problems.append(f'{rid} is both rejected and claimed')
for f in feats:
    for i in f['raw_ids']:
        if i not in raw:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} claims unknown raw {i}")

ids = collections.Counter(f['id'] for f in feats)
problems += [f'duplicate feature id {k}' for k, v in ids.items() if v > 1]
for f in feats:
    if f['page'] not in pages:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} on unknown page {f['page']}")
    for s in f['see_also']:
        if s not in pages:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} see_also unknown page {s}")
        if s == f['page']:
            problems.append(f"{f['id']} see_also its own page")
    if 'mirror_of' in f and f['mirror_of'] not in by_id:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mirror_of unknown {f['mirror_of']}")
    if 'mirror_of' in f and f['mirror_of'] == f['id']:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mirrors itself")
per_page = collections.Counter(f['page'] for f in feats)
for slug, (s, p) in pages.items():
    if per_page[slug] == 0:
        problems.append(f"page {slug} ({p['kind']}) has no feature")

for f in feats:
    body = json.dumps({k: v for k, v in f.items() if k not in ('raw_ids', '_seq')}, ensure_ascii=False)
    m = DEV.search(body)
    if m:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} mentions dev-only {m.group(0)}")
    m = re.search(r'spec §|road map|taxonomy|page scope', json.dumps({k: f[k] for k in ('name', 'summary', 'details')}, ensure_ascii=False), re.I)
    if m:
        problems.append(f"{f['id']} carries an author note: {m.group(0)}")

# Duplicate detector over what is left: every flagged pair must be linked or
# listed as distinct.
distinct = {frozenset(p): why for why, l in DISTINCT.items() for p in l}
shared = collections.Counter()
for r, l in claimed.items():
    for a, b in itertools.combinations(sorted({f['id'] for f in l if f['id'] in by_id}), 2):
        shared[(a, b)] += 1
T = {f['id']: toks(f['summary']) for f in feats}
N = {f['id']: norm(f['name']) for f in feats}
U = {f['id']: {norm(u) for u in f['ui']} - GENERIC_UI for f in feats}
flagged = []
for a, b in itertools.combinations(feats, 2):
    if a['page'] == b['page']:
        continue
    x, y = a['id'], b['id']
    n = shared.get((x, y), 0) + shared.get((y, x), 0)
    same = N[x] == N[y]
    j = jac(T[x], T[y])
    uis = U[x] & U[y]
    hit = False
    if same and (n or j >= .3 or (uis and j >= .15)):
        hit = True
    elif n and j >= .4:
        hit = True
    elif j >= .7 and len(T[x]) >= 5:
        hit = True
    elif n and sim(N[x], N[y]) >= .8:
        hit = True
    if not hit:
        continue
    if b['page'] in a['see_also'] or a['page'] in b['see_also']:
        continue
    if frozenset((x, y)) in distinct:
        continue
    flagged.append((x, a['page'], a['name'], y, b['page'], b['name'], n, round(j, 2)))
for row in flagged:
    problems.append('unresolved duplicate: %s [%s] "%s" <> %s [%s] "%s" raw=%d j=%s' % row)

if problems:
    print(f'{len(problems)} problems')
    for p in problems:
        print(' ', p)
    sys.exit(1)

json.dump(taxonomy, open(f'{B}/taxonomy.json', 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

for rid, (fid, why) in ABSORB.items():
    W.append(f'- `{rid}` "{raw[rid]["name"]}" absorbed into `{fid}`: {why}.')
W.append('')
W.append('## Records rejected\n')
W.append(f'One reason, one record. The other {sum(len(v) for v in section_rejections.values()) - 1} section-level rejections were "belongs to X" or a duplicate note on records another section does claim, so none of them removes anything.\n')
for k, v in rejected_final.items():
    W.append(f'- `{k}` "{raw[k]["name"]}": {v}')
W.append('')
W.append('## Duplicates merged\n')
W.append(f'{len(merge_log)} entries folded into the entry on the primary page. The kept entry takes the raw ids, details, ui and tools, lists the other page in `see_also` and the dropped id in `merged_from`.\n')
W.append('| Kept | Page | Dropped | From | Why this page |\n|---|---|---|---|---|')
for keep, kp, drop, dp, why in merge_log:
    W.append(f'| `{keep}` | {kp} | `{drop}` | {dp} | {why} |')
W.append('')
W.append('## Two entries kept on purpose\n')
W.append(f"Some pages exist to list things other pages own, so deleting the row would break the page's scope. These stay, carry `mirror_of` naming the owning entry, and link both ways by `see_also`. A page writer should keep a mirror to a line and a link.\n")
for k, v in mirror_log.most_common():
    W.append(f'- {k}: {v}')
W.append(f'- MCP tool catalogue rows on `mcp/tools-*`: {tool_rows} of {len(tools)} defer to an owner. {len(tool_no_owner)} have no single UI home and stand alone: {", ".join("`" + t + "`" for t in tool_no_owner)}.')
W.append(f'- Tool notes on feature pages linked to their catalogue row: {tool_notes}.')
W.append(f'- Same-name pairs on a reference or tool page sharing a source record, linked: {ref_links}.')
W.append(f'- A general rule and its case, linked only: {len(LINKS)}.\n')

"Same ui path" likewise: sub-controls of one sheet share a path, so the check is on the entry the path\'s last segment names.\n')
